```{r data}
data("colorOfMusic", package = "data4PCCAR")
tab <- colorOfMusic$contingencyTable
```

```{r interactive}
I <- nrow(tab)
J <- ncol(tab)
res.sca <- sparseCA(
  DATA = tab,
  components = 2L,
  rdsLeft = sqrt(I) * c(0.35, 0.35),
  rdsRight = sqrt(J) * c(0.35, 0.35))

dat.row <- data.frame(
  res.sca$fi,
  colorOfMusic$colorInformation) %>%
  dplyr::filter(X1 != 0 | X2 != 0)

dat.col <- data.frame(
  res.sca$fj, 
  musics = rownames(res.sca$fj),
  onclick = sprintf('var audio= new Audio("https://github.com/vguillemot/colorofmusic/raw/main/music/%s.mp3"); audio.play();', c("videogame", "jazz", "country", "rap", "pop", "opera", "lowF", "highF", "middleF"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(X1 != 0 | X2 != 0)

# dat.col$onclick <- sprintf('var audio= new Audio("https://github.com/vguillemot/colorofmusic/raw/main/music/%s.mp3"); audio.play();', c("videogame", "jazz", "country", "rap", "pop", "opera", "lowF", "highF", "middleF"))


pc.int <- ggplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey") +
  geom_label(aes(X1, X2, color = I(colorCodes), label = colorNames),
             dat.row, size = 4, fontface = 2) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(X1, X2, onclick = onclick), dat.col, shape = "♪", size = 4) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(X1, X2, label = musics), dat.col, fontface = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Dim. 1 (38.6%)",
       y = "Dim. 2 (25.9%)",
       title = "CA factor map")


girobj <- girafe(
  ggobj = pc.int)

girobj

```
